name: SPYCHIP
description: $SPYCHIP follows Agent Pixel, a cartoon spy with a tiny chip sidekick and one mission: sneak into a very expensive GPU rack. Fluent in 12 languages, none of them "export license." Trained on 10 trillion tokens. No roadmap, no utility, no idea what it's doing. Just vibes, chips, and plausible deniability. Not financial advice. Not a spy. Probably...
